We are looking for a

Senior Tech Consultant – Microsoft Dynamics (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) Join our team at one of our locations in Berlin, Baden-Baden, Verl or Tallinn – flexible working conditions available

Shape the future of our Microsoft Dynamics landscape and help drive our digital transformation. As a Senior Tech Consultant in our Dynamics Team, you will be at the heart of designing, stabilizing, and evolving our Dynamics 365 ecosystem — from Customer Engagement to Finance & Operations, including integrations, governance, and cross-tenant transformations.In this senior role, you will act as a trusted advisor, lead complex technical initiatives, steer platform evolution, and design future-proof solutions that are deeply embedded in our business processes.
Your expertise ensures that our Dynamics platform remains stable, resilient, compliant, and ready to scale with the growing demands of the organization — enabling innovation, operational excellence, and measurable business impact.

What will be the challenges in the role:

- Partner with business and IT stakeholders to guide strategic and transformational initiatives across the Microsoft Dynamics landscape (D365 CE, D365 FO, Customer Insights, Marketing, Field Service).
- Establish and further strengthen the AI-Driven CRM System with an agentic approach.
- Translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements, including user stories, interface specifications, and integration concepts.
- Lead and shape our Dynamics strategy, including governance frameworks, solution standards, customization guidelines, and high-quality processes.
- Drive platform stability and compliance, ensuring data integrity, system performance, and adherence to security and regulatory requirements.
- Coordinate testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities, and support business stakeholders during major releases and platform changes.
- Develop and present solution concepts, reference architectures, and technical roadmaps that enable informed decision-making.
- Collaborate with internal and external partners to integrate Dynamics with surrounding systems (Power Platform, Jira/Atlassian, Data Platform, SAP, and external services).
- Guide and coach internal team members to strengthen our Dynamics expertise and establish best practices across development, operations, and governance.Manage relationships across business units, product owners, and cross-functional IT teams to ensure transparent communication, aligned priorities, and smooth delivery.

What will help to succeed in the role:

- Extensive hands-on experience (5+ years) with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CE, FO, Customer Insights/Marketing) including application lifecycle, customization, data models, security roles, and integrations.
- Developer Languages like Java Script etc. are welcomed.
- Deep understanding of requirements engineering, process analysis, solution design, and technical documentation for Dynamics-based transformations.
- Proven expertise in platform governance, compliance, and quality management across complex Dynamics environments.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.Strategic and analytical mindset, able to balance technical depth with business-oriented decision-making.
- Experience with agile methodologies, project management practices, and solution architecture principles.
- Proactive, solution-oriented approach with a strong ownership mentality and the ability to work under pressure in complex multi-tenant setups.
- Fluent in English; German is a plus.

jobs.description:
Global Commodity Manager Valves & Actuators

Job Title  Corporate Commodity Manager (f/m/d) Valves & Actuators Location: Germany, Sweden, US Department: SE P DM SYS RA Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis Mode of Employment: Full-time / Permanent A Snapshot of Your Day  The organization Strategic Procurement, Direct Material is responsible for developing and implementing procurement strategies for direct materials and services that will ensure the optimization of Siemens Energy’s competitive position. As a Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, you will be part of Corporate Strategic Procurement team (SE P DM SYS RA), lead a cross-functional team globally and are responsible for a Corporate commodity strategy. Focus is on developing and managing a Valves & Actuator suppliers Typical day for Corporate Commodity Manager includes define/execution of commodity strategies, negotiation with suppliers, supplier relationship management, supplier contract management, reporting, problem solving and escalation handling, supply chain risk mitigation as well as alignment meetings with internal/external x-functional team. How You’ll Make an Impact  The successful candidate will be the Corporate Commodity Manager for Valves & Actuators, which includes: Manage commodity globally and across organizations and develop, implement, and maintain a global commodity strategy for Valves & Actuators, in alignment with business units. Conduct market analysis, cost structure analysis, and supply landscape evaluations. Identify cost‑saving opportunities, to include innovation pathways Maintain a strong external network of Valve & Actuator OEM’s, which include new supplier development. Identify, evaluate, and approve strategic suppliers based on capability, sustainability, quality, and cost. Build long‑term supplier relationships and lead supplier business reviews, scorecard evaluations, and follow-up actions. Ensure business continuity by preparing risk mitigation plans and dual/multi sourcing concepts. Internal and external management around demand vs supply in terms of capacity management. Internal and external management around market intelligence, which includes but is not limited to Market trends (cost drivers, M&A, demand). Geopolitical and supply chain risk impact, competitor and supplier landscape. Prepare and run quarterly business reviews / executive alignment Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing, terms, capacity and service agreements and manage framework contracts, SLAs, pricing and supply agreements. Ensure suppliers meet environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards. Be strong interface to lead commodity circles with R&D, Cost-Value Engineering, Supplier Quality Development as well as other procurement functions. What You Bring Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Packaging Technology, or a related field. 5–10 years’ experience in strategic procurement, preferably in Direct Materials in Energy, Oil & Gas, Process Industry. Packaging experience is strongly preferred. Strong commercial and negotiation skills. Knowledge in supply and supplier markets for Valves & Actuators. Operations experience (Manufacturing and SCM), ideally in a leadership position are a plus Excellent analytical capabilities and structured problem-solving. Strong stakeholder management capabilities across functions and regions. Ability to integrate and influence in a matrix organization and drive corporate initiatives Excellent knowledge of contract law and export control Knowledge in geo-political cost management strategies Fluent English; German and other languages are a plus Position is posted for Germany, Sweden, US Travel percentage ~25%   About the Team The SE P DM SYS RA organization is responsible for managing 3rd party spend as well as developing procurement strategies of direct material fields for Rotating Equipment and Auxiliaries that will allow Siemens Energy to maintain competitive position in marketplace and support company’s vision to become the most valued energy technology company Our professional procurement team utilizes modern tools and processes to develop global sourcing strategy for assigned commodities, that delivers optimal supply cost, quality, on time delivery, ESG (Environment, Social & Governance) compliant and VUCA resilient supply chain for Business Unit to improve competitive advantage for Siemens Energy.

The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computer science, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in a unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. Some 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.

Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.

Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.

You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!

How you will make an impact?

The main objective of the LUCA program is to successfully upgrade METRO’s Finance to SAP S/4HANA to ensure business continuity and avoid security and compliance risks. The LUCA program is, in addition, a critical enabler of METRO’s strategy to achieve standardization, harmonization, and centralization.

As a Technical Architect within the LUCA program, you will design and implement SAP finance solutions to optimize financial processes, review business requirements to deliver effective and standardized solutions. You will have a focus on Subledgers, namely on Account Receivable processes. Thus, the role requires deep expertise in SAP’s subledgers modules such as AR, AP, SD and Serrala’s Autobank solution, combined with hands-on experience in implementation and application support.

- Collaborate with finance, process, and IT teams to convert requirements into practical technical designs;
- Lead project rollouts solutioning of business requirements, from solution design to implementation, while analyzing complex changes and troubleshooting issues;
- Ensure solutions align with Metro’s global template, enterprise architecture, SAP best practices, and compliance standards;
- Simplify and convey technical concepts to diverse audiences, including executives, business users, and technical teams;
- Oversee SI partner delivery by reviewing and approving requirements refinement, high level and detailed design documents, transports, customizing documentation.

- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or related field, with strong knowledge of Financial Accounting and Indirect Procurement;
- 10+ years in SAP AP, AR, SD, with familiarity in SAP Fiori and SAP Business Technology Platform and Serrala’s Autobank as a plus;
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;
- Finance-related SAP certifications are advantageous;
- Retail industry experience preferred for tailored SAP solutions;
- Excellent English proficiency (written and spoken);
- Willingness and ability to travel as required.

We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.

We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.
